format: Southern Islands (SI, 2001): the 18 Southern Islands promo cards. Unlimited only.

attacks.name: Rainbow Wave
attacks.text: Choose a type of Energy other than Colorless attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon of that type (including Benched Pokémon). No Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Supersonic Flight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Bawl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Strange Scent
attacks.text: Each player flips a coin. Each player who gets heads chooses a total of 3 damage counters from among their Pokémon and removes them (all of them if they have fewer).

attacks.name: Sharp Teeth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tempting Eyes
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Rainbow Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Tentacle Grip
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. For each heads, draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Squirt
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. No Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Gentle Song
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). If the Defending Pokémon has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Sharpshooter
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. No Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Revelation
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Lick Wounds
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) with damage counters on it and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1).

attacks.name: Tongue Stretch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. No Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Paradise Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 2 damage counters from this Pokémon (1 if it only has 1), then, if you have any Benched Pokémon with damage counters on them, choose 1 of them and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1). (Tails: nothing happens, your ruling.)

attacks.name: Horrid Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Rampage
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon is now Confused (after doing damage).
